description: Nucleoid cancels a stock reservation and restores its live availability model
code:
stock = 6
available = stock - 1
try
    stock = 0
    throw "RESERVE"
catch
    assert(error, "RESERVE")
assert(stock, 6)
assert(available, 5)
stock = 9
assert(available, 8)
available

description: Nucleoid returns structured shipping quotes through an independently compact catch header
Nucleoid restores a failed sensor update without disturbing another instance's rule
code:
class Sensor(reading: int):
    this.reading = reading
north = Sensor(2)
south = Sensor(5)
$Sensor.doubled = $Sensor.reading * 2
try
    north.reading = 9
    throw "CANCEL"
catch reason:
    assert(reason, "CANCEL")
assert(north.doubled, 4)
assert(south.doubled, 10)
north.reading = 3
assert(north.doubled, 6)
assert(south.doubled, 10)
north.doubled

description: Nucleoid propagates a nested recovery failure while preserving a frozen startup result
code:
base = 2
total = base * 5
startup = total.value
try
    try:
        base = 8
        throw "INNER"
    catch (issue):
        throw issue + "-OUTER"
catch failure
    assert(failure, "INNER-OUTER")
assert(base, 2)
assert(total, 10)
base = 3
assert(total, 15)
assert(startup, 10)
total
